event: First poetry evening in Eurazania nearing close
durable_outcomes: Arlequino announced intent to secure another poetry evening one week later at the same time; if there is sustained interest, he wants the event to become regular.
Theme expected from Arlequino and participating poets next week: comedy.
Collective poem praising Eurazania was completed by the evening's poets and publicly approved by the audience for performance at the festival.
Festival is 'Фестиваль Эуразании: Неделя силы'; user corrected countdown to 29 days at T+131 ~23:47.
Arlequino publicly said the festival name was придумал король; treat as his public statement unless independently confirmed elsewhere.
Publication names corrected by user: 'Под сенью пера' = daily publication; 'Муза' = weekly publication.
Leyla and the Madman was performed as a long adapted telling for Eurazania and dedicated by Arlequino to Eurazania and its people as a 'жемчужина моего творчества'.

Arlequino publicly framed the poem as an example of complete love and linked eternal love to loving the One who is eternal, gesturing upward; audience already had limited prior context that he calls the One God 'Аллах'.

Arlequino joked at the close that he needed to go to his Leyla and publicly claimed he had earlier told Rena he would go to a brothel if she did not come earlier; this is a public joke/claim, not confirmation of Rena's current location or reaction.
next_steps_not_yet_confirmed: Venue for next week's poetry evening has not yet been secured.
Regular status is not yet formally established.
Festival-stage slot still needs operational coordination.
Current location/reaction of Rena remains UNKNOWN until causally encountered or learned.
